description: Whether one email address subscribes to the user's Substack, read from Substack right now. A hit stamps the plan and status onto the matching contact; with `create` true a hit also becomes a new contact when nobody holds the address yet. Use it for 'is x@y.com a subscriber?'.

create.description: Create the contact when the address is new. Default false.

name: lookup_substack_subscriber
title: Look up a Substack subscriber
